timeline.subject: C-Cpp
timeline.detail: pass-by-value vs pass-by-pointer closed via own wordcount code (in_word flag across count_words_chunk calls) — correctly predicted double-count if in_word were pass-by-value across the fgets loop, named scanf as the same out-param pattern

timeline.subject: C-Cpp
timeline.detail: closed 0.1+0.2 != 0.3 float-rounding — derived binary-fraction mechanism (factor-of-5 denominator -> infinite binary expansion, same shape as 1/3 in decimal) unaided, landed fabs/epsilon consequence

timeline.subject: C-Cpp
timeline.detail: derived two's-complement bit mechanics unaided (-1 = invert+add-1, 127+1=-128 wraparound); closed signed-overflow-UB "why" via `if (x+1 < x)` overflow-check example — chased a naive -O0 vs -O2 test through a flag typo to a clean run, disassembled when result still contradicted prediction, and landed that the fold happens at GIMPLE (front-end IR), not the RTL optimizer -O0/-O2 gate

timeline.subject: C-Cpp
timeline.detail: predicted + confirmed sizeof(int/char/double/int*); hand-decoded a double's raw byte dump to verify the IEEE-754 1/11/52 sign/exponent/mantissa split and little-endian storage, catching a wrong assumption (value was 1.54, not 3.14) from the bits themselves; finished the void* thread - incompatible-pointer-type warning without it, type-punning garbage explained via the same mechanism as a printf format mismatch, named malloc/qsort as real void* uses

timeline.subject: C-Cpp
timeline.detail: closed the void* mechanism gap — can't dereference a void* directly, needs a cast to a concrete type first; mentor confirmed it as a solid win

timeline.subject: C-Cpp
timeline.detail: shipped phase 1 wordcount CLI (state machine + assert.h self-check), triggered format-string mismatch + OOB array errors on purpose, chased OOB into ASan and found its redzone misses far-off indices
